title: S-EVAL: Towards Automated and Comprehensive Safety Evaluation for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Automated generation of base risk and jailbreak attack prompts targeting occupational discrimination using an expert testing LLM, followed by evaluating the models' responses using a safety critique LLM.

Cross-linguistic comparison of safety scores by translating test prompts into multiple high-, medium-, and low-resource languages (English, Chinese, French, Korean, Bengali, and Swahili) to measure disparities in safety performance based on language environments.
